new_value: Completed and verified in-scope protected CoAP request/response round-trip. Existing production paths cover Python SecureDatagramChannel EDHOC-derived contexts and Rust lichen-node SecureStack, with independent RFC 8613 request/response vectors and Python/Rust byte-exact cross fixtures exercising role-swapped keys, AAD, no-PIV/fresh-PIV responses, malformed inputs, correlation errors, and replay rejection.
